newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London firmer, Nomura falls.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London firmer, Nomura falls.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London were steady to higher on Tuesday with shares in Nomura Securities Co Ltd featuring after news that the stockbroker had been barred from participating in Japanese Government Bond (JGB) auctions, dealers said.
Nomura's shares in London fell 35 yen to 1515 yen from their Tokyo close.
"It is the fact there has been news in Nomura that has caused the fall and not so much the content of the news, as we knew it was coming," said one dealer.
In London, the Nikkei 50 index rose 4.59 points to 1,595.98 after the Nikkei 225 index fell 14.40 points to 20,129.11 in Tokyo.
Dealers said shares in banks were mostly firmer as the yen stabilised against the dollar.
Sumitomo Bank gained 15 yen to 1,625 yen from its Tokyo close.
